correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT.md uses two positive SPD eigenvalues a>b>0 and delayed BB1 on odd k, BB2 on even k with an undelayed first BB1. Exact mode ratio epsilon_k=||P_a r_k||^2/||P_b r_k||^2 obeys epsilon_1=1/epsilon_0 and epsilon_(k+1)=c_k epsilon_k/epsilon_(k-1)^2, c_odd=1,c_even=(b/a)^2, verified independently by Fraction iterates for three (a,b) and nine mixed initials through seven delayed steps. Thus phi_(k+1)=phi_k-2phi_(k-1)+{0,-2log(a/b)}. The bounded forced 2-cycle p_even=-L/4,p_odd=-3L/4 is incompatible with phi1=-phi0 when L>0, so a genuine homogeneous oscillation with roots sqrt2 e^{±i theta} remains. Every four phases contain positive and negative excursions bounded below relative to (sqrt2)^k since theta∈(pi/3,pi/2), yielding two-sided exp(-C(sqrt2)^k) mode norm bounds and double-log exponent log(sqrt2). Pure eigenspace terminates in first step. Finite computation not used as proof of asymptotic.
